title: EPILOGUE // THE ASHEN QUEEN
narrative: Daenerys sits the Iron Throne amid falling ash that tastes of bone. The city is silent. The dragons roost on the shattered ribs of the Red Keep. She has won the throne of Aegon the Conqueror, but there is no one left in King's Landing to rule. In the distance, the first snows of winter begin to fall upon the Blackwater.
